name: Auto Decor
description: Adds a Decor button to the editor. It decorates your level with glowing shapes, hanging chains, particles and big background shapes, and sets up a color palette automatically.

palette.name: Palette
palette.description: Color scheme used for decoration. Random picks a different one each time.

color-shift.name: Color shifts
color-shift.description: Smoothly change to the next palette every few seconds of the level.

color-shift-interval.name: Shift interval (units)
color-shift-interval.description: Distance between palette changes. About 300 units is one second at normal speed.

recolor-bg.name: Recolor background and ground
recolor-bg.description: Also adds color triggers for the background, ground and line to match the palette.

shape-ids.name: Shape object IDs
shape-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs used for glowing shapes and particles.

chain-id.name: Chain object ID
chain-id.description: Object used for hanging chains under platforms. 0 turns chains off.

density.name: Edge decor (%)
density.description: How much decoration goes on the edges of your blocks.

particles.name: Particles (%)
particles.description: How many small floating sparkles appear along the level.

big-shapes.name: Big background shapes
big-shapes.description: Adds large translucent shapes behind the level for depth.

max-objects.name: Max objects per click
max-objects.description: Safety cap so the editor does not lag.
